### Broadcast Safe Area and Typography Floor

* **10% Title-Safe Zone**: Primary kinetic headlines, brand lockups, and end-card CTAs stay inside `x in [192, 1728]` and `y in [108, 972]` (`1536 x 864` safe box).
* **Callout Ring & Card Safe Margin**: Every callout ring and card stays `>= 48px` inside the `1920 x 1080` frame edges.
* **Minimum Font Floor**: Display headlines `64px..88px` (`weight 650..750`), Callout Line 1 `36px` (`weight 650`), Callout Line 2 `28px` (`weight 500`), Eyebrows/Pills `>= 22px` (`weight 600`).

### Single Pointer Rule

`video/scripts/record-take.mjs` already injects a crisp `#141413` vector cursor and `#10b981` mousedown ring directly into `take.mp4`. Never render a second synthetic cursor over `Footage` in Scenes 5, 7, 9, or 11; if emphasizing a click (`f=754`), use ring-only emphasis (`transparent` pointer).
